questions.prompt: Which DNS record type holds SPF, DKIM, and DMARC policies? (three letters)

options: The servers allowed to send mail for the domain

questions.prompt: What does `-all` at the end of an SPF record mean?
options: Mail from any server not listed fails

questions.prompt: SPF checks the From: header that people see in their mail program.
Where would a receiver find the DKIM public key for selector `s1` at `example.com`? (the full name)
Why does DKIM usually survive forwarding when SPF doesn't?
options: Forwarders re-sign every message with SPF
The signature travels inside the message, while SPF depends on which server's IP connects

questions.prompt: Which DMARC policy tells receivers to refuse failing mail outright?
Under which name is a domain's DMARC record published, for example.com? (the full name)
The usual DMARC rollout starts at p=reject on day one.
To pass DMARC, what has to be true?
options: SPF or DKIM passes, and its domain matches the From: header's domain
